messages:
Ira Pendleton: Hey everyone! 👋 I’m Ira — joined today on the Platform team. I work remote from Portland but I’m in SF next week if anyone wants to say hi in person. I bring a tiny record player and a fern named Bix. 🎶🌿
Alex Kim: Welcome Ira!! :tada: Where in Portland are you based?
Ira Pendleton: North Portland — by the St. Johns bridge. Big into kiteboarding and vinyls, low-key sourdough hobby. Also curious: does the office have a plant-watering rota or should I bring a squirt bottle? :seedling:
Jamie Liu: Hi Ira — welcome!! We don’t have a formal rota, usually folks on the 2nd floor water the common plants. Happy to add Bix to the rotation if you want.
Taylor Gomez: Welcome!! If you’re in SF next week, come to Friday rooftop pizza (6pm) — team meetup. I can bring a plant mister. :pizza:
Samira Khan: Love the fern name. Bix is adorable already. If you have a portable record player we should do a ~vinyl swap+coffee~ sometime. I’ll bring espresso. ☕️
Ira Pendleton: Omg yes vinyl swap. I’m very into 90s indie and some jazz — will bring a small box. Also — desk setup question: what’s the usual keyboard vibe? Mechanical or low-profile?
Priya Nair: We’re ~split~ 50/50. Lots of mech clackers in infra, silent low-profile in product. If you need a recommendation, I have a spare TKL you can borrow for the week.
Alex Kim: Also FYI — badge + locker combo is D-14, there’s a shared bike pump in the garage, and the rooftop plants are high-maintenance (watch out for aphids).
Ira Pendleton: Thanks — D-14 noted. I’ll bring a tiny aphid spray just in case. 😂
welcome-bot: Welcome message posted to #new-hires: "Say hi to Ira Pendleton — Platform — Portland/SF hybrid" :wave:
Jamie Liu: Quick poll: who wants sushi on the rooftop meetup vs pizza? React with :sushi: or :pizza:?
Samira Khan: :sushi: (but will happily eat pizza too)
Taylor Gomez: :pizza: I’ll order half pepperoni, half veggie.
Ira Pendleton: :sushi: — will bring a small stack of records as a bribe. Looking forward to meeting you all!"
